title: Postmortem: cart service outage during flash sale
summary: A flash-sale traffic spike exhausted the cart service database connection pool. The pool had no statement timeout, so a slow pricing query held connections until every worker starved. The incident ran 38 minutes: 4 to ack, 34 to roll back the pricing query and drain the pool.
contributing_factors: Pricing query shipped without a statement timeout
Connection pool sized for normal traffic, not sale traffic
No load test in CI for the flash-sale profile

incident.title: Cart service outage during flash sale

action_items.description: Add a 5s statement timeout to every cart-service query
Raise pool ceiling and add saturation alerting at 80%
Add a flash-sale load profile to the CI pipeline

title: Postmortem: SSO login throttling misconfiguration
summary: A config migration reset the SSO throttle window from 10 attempts to 2, locking out frequent SSO users for ~2 hours until the hotfix shipped.
contributing_factors: Throttle defaults lived in code, not in the config store
Config migration lacked a regression test

incident.title: Login throttling misconfigured for SSO users

action_items.description: Move throttle defaults into the config store
Add a regression test covering config migrations
